post.description: Creates a batch of web conversion events in Snapchat Conversions.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

pixelId.description: Snapchat Pixel ID that owns the web events.

data.description: Array of web conversion events to send in one request.

data[].eventName.description: Snap standard or custom event name for the web event.

data[].eventTime.description: Epoch timestamp in seconds or milliseconds for when the event happened.

data[].eventSourceUrl.description: Web page URL where the event took place.

data[].userData.description: User matching fields for the event.

data[].userData.clientIpAddress.description: Device IP address for matching. Do not hash.

data[].userData.clientUserAgent.description: Device user agent string. Recommended for web events.

data[].userData.em.description: Normalized SHA-256 email hashes for user matching.

data[].eventId.description: Unique event identifier used for deduplication.

parameters.description: Where the event took place.

parameters.name: data[].eventSourceUrl
parameters.description: URL where the web event occurred.

parameters.description: User matching fields for the event.
